title: Stationary Online Contention Resolution Schemes: Theory and Applications to Bayesian Online Resource Allocation
summary: Motivated by problems in Bayesian reusable resource allocation, we introduce the concept of stationary online contention resolution schemes (S-OCRSs). OCRSs are a central tool used to solve non-reusable resource allocation problems. They convert solutions to fluid approximations of problems into feasible online policies while approximately preserving allocation probabilities. S-OCRSs depart from standard OCRSs in that they ensure that the probability of allocating any given set of resources is independent of the arrival order of requests.
